scope: Different-author source-only hammer of M2003. It used the official source test, source describe/preflight before review creation, static checks, and synthetic temporary-directory mutation attacks. No remote archive, canonical payload, shard, merge, reducer, GPU or EDA was opened or executed.

p1.finding: validate_runtime_authority accepts stopped_pids=[] because all(generator over empty) is true. A synthetic exact-shape review/release returned authority successfully without testing any PID. The release schema does not bind the actual local controller or its descendants/starttimes.
p1.impact: A release can authorize archive/merge/reducer while the local three-worker campaign is still writing the same namespaces, creating races and ambiguous overlap state.
p1.required_repair: Bind a sealed nonempty stop receipt for the actual controller and all descendants, including PID, starttime and command identity; require that exact set in the release and prove every member stopped before archive open or namespace mutation. Add the empty and unrelated-dead-PID attacks as regressions.

p1.finding: merge_and_reduce verifies and installs each remote ordinal in one loop. A synthetic two-ordinal attack produced verify0, install0, postinstall_verify0, verify1, then failed on corrupt ordinal1.
p1.impact: A late corrupt shard leaves a partially imported canonical namespace even though the one-shot merge fails. This contradicts verify-every-remote-shard-before-merge and makes the release count/recovery boundary ambiguous.
p1.required_repair: First verify all 4,200 staged shards and materialize an immutable verified import plan; only then mutate canonical namespaces. Add a sealed import attempt/journal with explicitly authorized resumability for crash recovery, while retaining O_EXCL/no-overwrite per-shard install.

p1.finding: inspect_archive opens the tar once and extract_archive_once reopens the path a second time. The future release authorizes archive_open=1. No overall merge attempt-consumed namespace exists, and the second path open is not bound to the file object hashed by the first open.
p1.impact: The implementation exceeds its exact open authorization and admits a path-replacement TOCTOU between inspection and extraction; after a partial failure the same release may be invoked again.
p1.required_repair: Consume an O_EXCL overall attempt before the first open and use one immutable regular-file descriptor for SHA verification, population inspection and extraction, or explicitly authorize and cryptographically reverify a second immutable descriptor. Seal failure/recovery state without deleting or overwriting prior evidence.

p1.finding: The local 0..4499 precheck calls M1688.verify_sealed_shard but never requires the returned row.release_sha256 to equal M1706_RELEASE_SHA256. The inherited verifier validates against row.get('release_sha256'), so that argument is self-selected rather than authority-pinned.
p1.impact: A sealed local prefix from another authority can enter the final M1688 reduction even though M2003 claims an exact M1706 campaign identity.
p1.required_repair: For all 8,700 accepted rows, require release_sha256 == M1706_RELEASE_SHA256 before any mutation and add a wrong-but-self-consistent local release attack as a regression.

p1.finding: Actual M1681 receipts have 22 top-level keys. deterministic_core retains 20 and excludes both rss and independent_result_hammer_pending. Flipping the latter from true to false leaves overlap equality unchanged; the official test checks only that rss is absent and len(core)==20.
p1.impact: Local/remote overlap can disagree on a deterministic claim-readiness field while being accepted as equal, violating the stated RSS-only exclusion rule.
p1.required_repair: Construct the comparison from the exact validated receipt key set minus only rss, explicitly include independent_result_hammer_pending, reject unknown/missing top-level keys, and preserve this mutation as a regression.

p2.finding: The 65-line official test checks range cardinality, four unsafe member names, RSS omission and a missing archive. It does not exercise an exact synthetic archive, duplicate/link/special members, stopped-PID authority, all-before-mutate ordering, overlap mismatches, partial install recovery, or release reuse.
p2.disposition: The successor should add synthetic temporary-directory regressions for every P1 before a new independent source review.

single_next_action: Create an additively numbered successor that closes all five P1 findings, then obtain a fresh different-author source hammer. Do not create M2005 from M2003/M2004.
